sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Kumar Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Devendra Kumar Mishra Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material on record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-Kundan Pandey for enlarging him on bail in Case Crime No.388 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 304-B, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Ecotech-III, District Gautambudh Nagar.

entities.text: Police Station Ecotech-III, District Gautambudh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in present case.

He further submits that the marriage of the applicant was solemnised with the deceased on 02.03.2020 and that the first information report has been lodged on 13.09.2022 with regard to the incident alleged to have taken place on 14.08.20222 without there Kundan Pandey vs State Of U.P. on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153895634/
1 being any plausible explanation of such an inordinate delay.

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that the applicant is permanent resident of State of Bihar, however, he was engaged in Real Estate Business under the partnership at Noida due to which, calls were made by the male and female in odd hours, which was objected by the deceased but since applicant's job was such, he could not avoid the calls, therefore, the deceased under anger and annoyance had committed suicide as is evident from the perusal of the post mortem report.

Learned counsel has next argued that at the time of cremation the entire family members of the both sides were present but after a lapse of few days, the informant's side were making pressure upon the the applicant to transfer 5 bighas of land and constructed house situated at NOIDA, on refusal by the applicant, the instant prosecution has been initiated against the applicant and his father.

Learned counsel further submits that the prosecution story is totally false and fabricated and therefore no offence is made out against the applicant and therefore, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

It was further argued that the applicant is languishing in jail since 17.09.2022 having no criminal history and that in case,
applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in the trial.

Per contra, learned A.G.A.as well as learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that the applicant is the husband of the deceased and his innocence cannot be adjudged at pre trial stage.

Learned counsel for the informant further submits that out of the said conjugation, one female child was also born on account of which, the applicant used to harass the deceased mentally and physically which ultimately resulted into the present offence.
Learned counsel has next argued that the statements of the informant as well as other witnesses have specifically supported the prosecution version therefore, he does not deserve any indulgence.
In case the applicant is released on bail he will again indulge in similar activities and will misuse the liberty of bail.

Perusal of the record shows that the marriage between the applicant and the deceased was solemnised on 02.03.2020 and deceased died within a short span of about two years and that the female child of the deceased is living with her grandfather (Nana).The statements of the informant and other witness shows that there was continuous demand of dowry on account of which, the instant offence has been committed by the applicant.
He further submits that the minor child of the deceased is living at her maternal house.

Keeping in view submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of offence, nature of allegations and all the attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, no case for bail has been made out.
Accordingly, the bail application of applicant-Kundan Pandey is rejected.
